crossRefs.note: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.
Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.
on the third day, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul, with his clothes torn, and earth on his head. When he…
Then David took hold on his clothes, and tore them; and all the men who were with him did likewise.
Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore her garment of various colors that was on her; and she laid her hand on her head…

translations.web: Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey, and returned to the city.
translations.bsb: Then they all tore their clothes, loaded their donkeys, and returned to the city.
translations.kjv: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.
translations.asv: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.
